text:
lina: Quick heads-up 1:30 AM PT 11 1 I've dropped the latest launch post draft in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-post-draft. Need two small things checked by EOD: hero angle approval and the benchmark language. Also confirm webinar lead routing mapping.

devin: reading now. love the narrative around predictable inference costs. two nitpicks: can we tighten the first paragraph by 1-2 lines, and adjust the subhead to mention latency+cost tradeoffs?

lina: agree on trimming. maya can you take head edit?

maya: on it. will keep the opening strong and cut ~30 words. also will add a micro-CTA inline for the benchmarks section.

prashant: bench numbers 1:45 AM PT 11 1 FYI the public-friendly phrasing needs to avoid internal config names. suggest: "median latency ~58ms (p95 ~120ms) on typical 2k-token generation in Redwood-hosted tests; see methodology link." will DM ops to get a sanitized excerpt.

sam: legal check: avoid absolutes like "no compromise in quality" and any SLA-looking phrasing. prefer "consistent" and "reliable" instead. also need to vet the benchmark table caption.

lina: noted. maya please swap out any absolutes in the risk/benefit paragraph.

maya: done. replaced with "maintains high output quality across quantized variants" 1:52 AM PT 11 

devin: CTA strategy: we should steer self-serve signups to the free tier landing, and enterprise interest to a demo request. can we add a tiny JSON snippet for web so product ops can wire it?

sam: i'll review the legal copy after the edit.

lina: snippet would be great. prashant can you confirm if we should mention specific pricing in the launch post or link to pricing page?

prashant: don't list precise price numbers in the blog; link to pricing. we can show an illustrative "cost per 1k tokens" example but mark it as illustrative.

devin: ok sample mapping here 1:57 AM PT 11 (drop into CMS)
{"cta_try": {"label":"Try Redwood API 00 Free Tier","href":"/signup?utm_source=launch"}, "cta_enterprise": {"label":"Request a Demo","href":"/enterprise/contact?utm_source=launch"}}

maya: thanks. will add to the CMS ticket. web ops: who owns the HubSpot routing? need to ensure webinar registrants are segmented by which CTA they click during the webinar follow-up.

sam: ops note: webinar registrants flow -> 'Launch Webinar - All' list. For clicks: if user clicks enterprise CTA from follow-up, send to SDR queue (enterprise). otherwise move to nurture sequence. @devin can own the HubSpot config?

devin: I can take HubSpot config. will create two follow-up templates: self-serve & enterprise. link them to CTA tracking parameters. will set UTM so we can attribute conversions.

content-bot: Editorial checklist: missing SEO meta + OG image alt text. See https://wiki.redwood-inference/marketing/editorial-checklist. Also reminder to add image alt that mentions "Redwood inference" for SEO.

lina: design: we want the new hero illustration (assets/illustrations/2026/launch-hero.svg). can you export 1200x630 + 800x420 + 400x210?

design (via maya): pinged design; they'll deliver exports by tomorrow noon.

prashant: ops DM sent for sanitized bench excerpt; expect by 3pm. once we have that I'll provide the public methodology link (sanitized).

sam: legal greenlight pending final phrasing. once prashant posts sanitized excerpt, i'll do a final pass.

lina: timeline: if edits and legal pass by 5pm, we publish next Thursday 10am PT. If anything blocks, call it out here.

devin: CMS ticket created and assigned to web-ops: https://cms.redwood-inference/tickets/556. includes JSON mapping.

maya: editorial pass done, tracked changes in doc. left two optional headline variants.

prashant: public methodology link (sanitized): https://perf.redwood-inference/benchmarks/launch-method-public. uses aggregated metrics only.

sam: legal approved the revised benchmark language and removed absolutes. :white_check_mark:

lina: perfect 1:59 AM PT 11 closing the loop: prashant to confirm public link, devin to wire HubSpot + CMS, maya to finalize hero/subhead edits, design to export hero, content-bot checklist to be marked done once SEO + OG are added. If all done by 5pm I'll merge and schedule. thanks everyone :rocket:
